Amazon has sued Perplexity AI for unauthorized access and is promoting its own AI shopping assistant, Rufus, highlighting a tension between controlling AI agents and embracing their potential benefits for customer experience.

title: 5 Small-Cap Stocks to Consider as Investors Flee Mega-Cap Tech
summary: Capital is rotating away from mega-cap tech stocks (the 'Magnificent Seven') into small-cap value and cyclical stocks. The Russell 2000 has surged as investors seek broader market exposure tied to real economic activity. The article highlights five small-cap stocks positioned to benefit from this sector rotation trend.

title: Freedom Holding plans to acquire another bank and marketplace in Kazakhstan
summary: Freedom Holding Corp. CEO Timur Turlov announced plans to acquire another bank and a local marketplace in Kazakhstan, as well as a second-tier bank in Turkey. The company is considering issuing up to $500 million in bonds to finance these acquisitions and also plans to expand its SuperApp into a digital ecosystem in the U.S. Additionally, Freedom Holding aims to raise an extra $200-300 million for technology investments, including a sovereign AI hub with Nvidia.

title: Nebius Group Targets Early Nvidia Vera Rubin Deployment For AI Clients
summary: Nebius Group (NasdaqGS:NBIS) plans to be an early commercializer of Nvidia's Vera Rubin NVL72 AI infrastructure, integrating it into its cloud offerings for enterprise clients needing high-performance AI workloads. This strategic move aims to position Nebius more competitively against hyperscale cloud providers by offering advanced infrastructure for computationally intensive AI tasks. For investors, this development signals Nebius's commitment to scaling GPU supply and deepening its role in the AI ecosystem, though execution risks and competition from larger cloud platforms remain.

title: SpaceX rivals AST SpaceMobile and Rocket Lab join space-stock selloff
summary: SpaceX rivals AST SpaceMobile and Rocket Lab are experiencing a significant selloff in their stock prices this week. An analyst suggests these losses might be partly connected to a broader software industry rout. AST SpaceMobile saw its shares drop over 10% after AT&T partnered with Amazon Web Services and Amazon's satellite-internet business.

title: Meet the "Magnificent Seven" Stock Berkshire Hathaway and Investing Legend Warren Buffett Should Have Bought. (Hint: It's Not Apple, Amazon, or Alphabet.)
summary: The article argues that Meta Platforms should have been added to Berkshire Hathaway's portfolio alongside Apple, Amazon, and Alphabet. Despite Buffett's historical avoidance of tech stocks, Meta possesses a strong economic moat through its network effects, 3.58 billion daily active users, and data collection capabilities. With 177% share growth over five years, Meta represents a missed opportunity that future Berkshire leadership under Greg Abel may reconsider.

title: Amazon expands access to digital assistant Alexa+
summary: Amazon has expanded access to its AI-upgraded digital assistant, Alexa+, to all US users, nearly a year after its early access launch. The service is designed to handle various tasks like managing calendars, booking reservations, and controlling smart home devices. Alexa+ is available on Alexa-enabled devices, the Alexa app, and web browsers, with free access for Prime members or a monthly subscription for non-members, and has seen high engagement during its preview.

title: New Walmart CEO is not afraid to take risks, analyst says
summary: John Furner, the new CEO of Walmart, is described by analyst Oliver Chen as a leader with a higher appetite for risk than his predecessor, a necessary trait in a technology-driven environment. Furner plans to spend his initial weeks visiting stores and facilities, engaging directly with employees to understand their challenges. This approach reinforces the company's commitment to innovation and improving operations, as it navigates challenges from competitors like Amazon in both grocery and pharmacy sectors.

title: PayPal Leadership Shake-Up - Former HP Exec Hired As New CEO
summary: PayPal Holdings, Inc. (PYPL) experienced a leadership change with Enrique Lores, former HP Inc. CEO, appointed as its new President and CEO, effective March 1. The announcement led to a premarket stock decline, reflecting investor uncertainty despite the Board's confidence in Lores's ability to drive innovation. This shift follows PayPal's subpar Q4 performance, missing analyst estimates for both earnings and sales, and comes as analysts maintain a "Hold" rating on the stock with a cautious outlook due to weak momentum and quality scores.

title: 3 Brilliant Growth Stocks to Buy Now and Hold for the Long Term
summary: The article recommends three growth stocks for long-term investment: Nvidia, benefiting from AI infrastructure buildout with a forward P/E of 24.5; Meta Platforms, leveraging AI for ad revenue growth with expected Q1 2026 acceleration and a forward P/E of 23.5; and Amazon, leveraging e-commerce and cloud computing leadership with a forward P/E of 25.

title: AI security worries stall enterprise production deployments
summary: Enterprise AI adoption is being significantly hindered by security concerns, as highlighted by executives from Cisco, OpenAI, and AWS, and a Black Duck report. There's a growing "trust deficit" in AI, leading to slower production deployments despite rapid technological advancements. Experts emphasize the need for new security paradigms, data access controls, and a shift towards making security a prerequisite rather than an afterthought for AI systems.

title: Jim Cramer on Wells Fargo: "That's a Winner"
summary: Jim Cramer has expressed a bullish view on Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE: WFC), identifying it as a "winner" for its adoption of AI technology to enhance efficiency. Cramer stated that Wells Fargo is a key holding for his Charitable Trust due to its strong approach to implementing AI for efficiency.

title: Radware Unveils Agentic AI Protection Solution to Shield Enterprises from New Agentic Threats
summary: Radware has launched its Agentic AI Protection Solution, expanding its platform into the AI security market. This solution is designed to protect autonomous AI agents from new threats like direct and indirect prompt injection attacks, tool abuse, and unauthorized data access. It leverages proprietary behavioral analysis to identify malicious intent in real-time, distinguishing it from traditional software-based guardrails, and comes after Radware's discovery of the "ZombieAgent" vulnerability.

The PlayStation gaming segment experienced a 4% revenue decrease but a 19% rise in operating income, driven by network services and first-party game sales.

title: A New Report Says AI Layoffs Are Backfiring and Half of Companies Will Start Rehiring
summary: A new report by Gartner suggests that companies that have laid off employees due to AI integration will likely rehire them. The report indicates that by 2027, 50% of companies that reduced headcount due to AI will bring back staff for similar functions, often finding that AI tools are not sufficient to replace human talent. This trend highlights the limitations of AI and the continued need for human expertise, particularly in roles requiring quality service and growth.

summary: Integral Ad Science Holding Corp. (IAS) recently appointed Bob Lord and Krishan Bhatia, both experienced in digital and streaming advertising, to its Board of Directors. summary: IREN Ltd, formerly a Bitcoin mining company, has dramatically shifted its focus to AI infrastructure through a $9.7 billion partnership with Microsoft. title: IonQ, the biggest quantum computing company on the stock market, disputes short-seller claims it failed to disclose holes in its revenue
summary: IonQ, a leading quantum computing company, is disputing claims made by short-seller Wolfpack Research regarding the quality of its revenues and insider stock sales. IonQ has denied these claims, stating that the report contains false and misleading information and affirms its path to shareholder value creation, while Wolfpack suggests recent acquisitions by IonQ are a way to "acquire revenue" to mask organic growth issues.

summary: Transcat (TRNS) reported a Q3 2026 loss of US$0.12 EPS and US$1.1 million net loss, despite revenue growth to US$83.9 million. The stock's high P/E of 83.5x and a DCF fair value significantly below the current price suggest a rich valuation, prompting investors to scrutinize future profitability and growth execution.

summary: The article recommends three growth stock ETFs for long-term investors amid a 2026 downturn in tech and megacap stocks. summary: The Unusual Whales Democratic ETF (NANC), which tracks the stock trades of Democratic members of Congress, has outperformed the S&P 500 since its launch in February 2023, growing 30% compared to the S&P 500's 24%. This success is attributed to significant investments in major tech companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, and Nvidia. title: Wholesaler's $100m plans for former Amazon warehouse near Watford
summary: Sysco, the world's largest food wholesaler, has announced a $100 million plan to repurpose a former Amazon warehouse in Hemel Hempstead, near Watford, into its largest depot in Europe. This initiative aims to significantly expand Sysco's capacity in the South East of Great Britain and is expected to create 850 jobs over the next decade. The 475,000-square-foot facility, which will include frozen and chilled areas, is projected to be fully operational by early 2026.

title: Equinix Fabric adds multi-cloud routing
summary: Equinix has made its virtual routing service, Fabric Cloud Router, generally available to enterprises leasing its data centers, allowing for in-house multi-cloud connectivity. This service provides Layer 3 connectivity to major cloud providers and other service providers, marketed as a monthly subscription that eliminates the need for physical or virtual routers. Equinix aims to simplify infrastructure complexity for hybrid cloud environments and support emerging technologies like private generative AI, positioning itself against competitors like Megaport with higher bandwidth capabilities.

title: ValueAct Holdings Trims Insight Enterprises by $99 Million as Enterprise IT Budgets Tighten
summary: ValueAct Holdings, L.P. sold over one million shares of Insight Enterprises (NASDAQ:NSIT) in Q4 2025, generating an estimated $98.95 million, as enterprise IT spending faces tightening budgets. The sale reduced ValueAct's stake in NSIT, which now accounts for 1.41% of its AUM and is no longer a top-five holding. This move comes as Insight Enterprises' stock has fallen significantly, highlighting investor concerns about the company's revenue model, which is sensitive to corporate spending shifts.

title: Pinnacle Financial Partners Takes Center Stage as the Exclusive Naming Rights Partner of Nashville Yards' State-of-the-Art Live Music Venue: "The Pinnacle"
summary: Pinnacle Financial Partners has secured the exclusive naming rights for Nashville Yards' upcoming 4,500-capacity music venue, which will now be known as "The Pinnacle." This long-term agreement deepens Pinnacle's ties to Nashville's entertainment market and the broader community development, with the venue set to open in early 2025. Operated by AEG Presents, The Pinnacle promises a world-class live entertainment experience, reinforcing Nashville's status as a global music hub.

title: Maestria Loads Up Shift4 Stock With 144,000 Shares Bought
summary: Maestria Partners LLC significantly increased its stake in Shift4 Payments by purchasing 143,763 shares worth approximately $10.16 million in Q4 2025, bringing its position to 9.5% of fund AUM. title: Top 10 AI Stocks in Focus on Wall Street – Nvidia, Broadcom & More
summary: Erste Group analyst Hans Engel downgraded IBM from Buy to Hold on February 18, 2026, citing slowing infrastructure momentum, weak consulting growth, and financial pressures despite IBM's positive AI outlook. title: Amazon: AI-assisted hacker breached 600 Fortinet firewalls in 5 weeks
summary: Amazon reports that a Russian-speaking hacker, leveraging generative AI services, breached over 600 FortiGate firewalls across 55 countries in just five weeks. The attacks exploited weak credentials and exposed management interfaces, with AI assisting in automating access, reconnaissance, and attack planning. This campaign demonstrates how AI lowers the barrier to entry for threat actors, enabling less skilled individuals to execute sophisticated attacks.

summary: The US economy is akin to a barge, slow to change direction, yet despite aggressive Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, economic data remains strong, with a resilient consumer and labor market. This outlook provides insights into investment views for equities and fixed income, highlighting the impact of AI on market leaders and discussing the inverted yield curve's implications while emphasizing the current housing affordability crisis.

summary: JPMorgan increased its price target on McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE:MH) to $22, maintaining an Overweight rating, following strong Q3 results and a raised outlook. summary: BofA analyst Curtis Nagle reinstated coverage of NIQ Global Intelligence plc (NYSE: NIQ) with a Buy rating and a $20 price target, expressing a generally constructive view on the Information and Business Services sector for 2026. title: Beyond the Barcode: Grocery's Robot Revolution
summary: Robots are increasingly transforming grocery stores and the foodservice industry by handling mundane tasks like inventory monitoring, cleaning, and assisting with food preparation. This automation helps fill labor gaps and allows human employees to focus on more complex customer service roles. While robots excel at efficiency and data reporting, challenges remain, particularly in handling delicate tasks like selecting produce, suggesting a future of symbiotic human-robot partnerships rather than displacement.

summary: IonQ announced that its most powerful commercial quantum computer, IonQ Aria, is now available on Amazon Braket, Amazon Web Services' quantum computing service. This expands IonQ's presence on the platform, allowing AWS users to choose between IonQ Aria and IonQ Harmony for more complex quantum algorithms. The availability of IonQ Aria, with 25 algorithmic qubits, is expected to enable new approaches in quantum computing across various industries.

title: Customer data stolen from GDS and STT GDC - report
summary: A security firm, Resecurity, has reported an ongoing campaign to steal customer data from data center firms, including GDS Holdings and ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC). The compromised data primarily involved emails and passwords for customer-support websites, affecting around 2,000 customers with prominent companies like Alibaba, Amazon, and Mastercard among them. While both GDS and STT GDC stated the compromised information posed no risk to clients' critical IT systems or data, Resecurity also found evidence of attempts to gather data on 30,000 CCTV cameras and IT staff credentials.

The stock could be a buying opportunity for AI believers, but investors should wait for Meta to demonstrate real AI-driven profits rather than continued blank-check spending.

summary: DXC Technology has partnered with AWS for the launch of the AWS Mainframe Modernization service, aiming to help organizations migrate and modernize mainframe applications on the AWS cloud. summary: Fred Smith, the founder of FedEx Corp., will step down as CEO on June 1, 2022, and transition to executive chairman. Smith, who started FedEx in 1973, will focus on global issues, while Subramaniam, who joined the company in 1991, will take the helm of operations.

summary: Bunge Global SA (NYSE:BG) recently received several price target upgrades and reaffirmed Buy/Overweight ratings from JPMorgan, UBS, Stephens, and BMO Capital on February 5. summary: IonQ announced that its quantum computer, IonQ Aria, has achieved a record 20 algorithmic qubits (#AQ), positioning it as the industry's most powerful quantum computer based on application-oriented benchmarks. summary: Rigetti Holdings announced the commercial availability of its 80-qubit quantum system, Aspen-M, through Rigetti Quantum Cloud Services and other platforms like Amazon Braket. summary: A federal judge has ordered Apple to allow developers to direct consumers to outside payment methods, challenging the company's 30% commission on App Store transactions. While the ruling found Apple engaged in anticompetitive conduct by preventing developers from offering cheaper prices, it stopped short of declaring the App Store a monopoly or allowing third-party app marketplaces. The company also raised its full-year 2026 guidance, expecting continued growth and efficiency gains from its technology-native approach.

title: S&P 500 Edges Higher Amid Mixed Mega-Cap Earnings; Dow Leads Market Indexes Overall
summary: U.S. stock indexes rose on April 30, 2026, with the Dow leading gains driven by Caterpillar's 10% surge on strong earnings. Mega-cap tech earnings were mixed: Alphabet soared 9.6% on robust Google Cloud revenue growth, while Meta and Microsoft fell on concerns about massive AI infrastructure spending. Nvidia declined 4.3% amid competition concerns. The market showed investors are now scrutinizing which companies convert AI hype into actual revenue.

title: A cybersecurity harbinger: Oracle front-runs AI model threat with new customer security advisory
summary: Oracle has issued a security advisory to its customers in response to new large AI models like Anthropic's Mythos, which significantly lower the cost and effort for attackers to discover software exploits and vulnerabilities. The advisory urges customers to update their Oracle databases, particularly those on-premises, to the latest versions (19c or 26ai) and apply quarterly Release Updates to implement security hardening developed with AI-assisted testing. This proactive move by Oracle highlights the urgent need for vendors and customers to adopt a new security posture that emphasizes continuous hardening, automated remediation, and proactive collaboration to defend against increasingly sophisticated AI-driven threats.

title: ServiceNow Benefits From Rich Partner Base: More Upside Ahead?
summary: ServiceNow is greatly benefiting from its extensive partner ecosystem, which acts as a key growth driver by enhancing product capabilities, accelerating AI adoption, and enabling expansion across various industries. While facing stiff competition from Salesforce and Microsoft in enterprise AI, these partnerships, combined with continuous platform innovation, position ServiceNow as a leading enterprise workflow and AI platform. Despite its stock underperforming and being overvalued, analysts project strong revenue growth for 2026, driven by its strategic alliances and AI-native offerings.

title: Rezolve AI Stock Rises After Revenue Tops All of 2025 in 90 Days
summary: Rezolve AI reported first-quarter revenue of $60 million, already surpassing its entire 2025 revenue of $46.8 million. The company's stock rose 4.9% on the news, and management remains confident in its $360 million revenue target for 2026 and achieving profitability without further equity sales. Rezolve is also actively pursuing a public campaign for Commerce.com, despite that company turning down its all-stock acquisition bid.

title: Amazon's Earnings Just Sent the Stock to New Highs—What's Next?
summary: Amazon's stock hit all-time highs following strong earnings that beat expectations on revenue and earnings. AWS growth accelerated to 28% year-over-year, driven by AI and cloud infrastructure demand. The company demonstrated that AI investments are translating into meaningful returns. However, with a 35% rally in over a month and high analyst price targets, the stock now faces a higher bar for continued growth, requiring sustained momentum to justify current valuations.

title: Prediction: These Will Be the Next $5 Trillion Companies
summary: The article predicts that Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon will become $5 trillion companies, following Nvidia's achievement. Their cloud computing businesses, powered by AI demand, are positioned to drive massive growth. Alphabet needs less than 20% growth to reach the target, while Microsoft could benefit from valuation expansion, and Amazon's highly profitable AWS segment generates most operating income.

title: O'Reilly Automotive Inc Stock (ORLY) Moved Up by 7.60% on Apr 30: Key Drivers Unveiled
summary: O'Reilly Automotive Inc (ORLY) stock rose 7.60% following strong first-quarter 2026 financial results that exceeded analyst expectations for earnings and revenue. The company reported 8.1% comparable store sales growth and updated its constructive full-year 2026 guidance. Despite some concerns about revenue guidance and a negative return on equity, robust operational performance and expansion plans fueled positive investor sentiment.

title: Newmont Corporation Stock (NEM) Moved Up by 3.29% on Apr 30: Facts Behind the Movement
summary: Newmont Corporation's stock (NEM) rose by 3.29% due to strong Q1 2026 financial results, which exceeded expectations, and an expanded share repurchase program. The increase was further supported by rising gold prices, fueled by inflation and geopolitical risks, and positive analyst ratings. Despite company-specific risks like elevated All-in Sustaining Costs and regulatory pressures, the stock performed well against its industry peers.

title: Goldman Sachs favors hyperscalers over chipmakers in AI infrastructure
summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Jim Covello suggests that investors should favor hyperscalers over chipmakers to profit from the AI infrastructure buildout. This recommendation is based on the belief that the market has undervalued hyperscalers, despite their significant capital spending on data centers, while chip stocks have already seen substantial gains. Covello posits that if hyperscalers demonstrate a positive return on investment, their valuations could recover, offering more upside than the already-rewarded chip sector.

title: Veritone (VERI) Launches Next-Gen Discovery Content Intelligence Solution with VERI AI Agent
summary: Veritone (VERI) has launched its next-gen Discovery Content Intelligence solution, featuring a sophisticated AI agent named VERI. This platform transforms media archives into conversational assets, enabling organizations to query, summarize, and analyze vast audio and video libraries using NL interaction. The VERI AI agent utilizes a multi-model cognitive architecture for precise media analysis and ad verification, enhancing workflows across various teams.

title: MongoDB Could Be Setting Up for a Sharp Earnings Rebound
summary: MongoDB's stock has been oversold due to market overreaction to AI disruption fears and cautious Q1 2026 guidance, despite strong Q4 2025 results and robust full-year outlook. With analysts setting a low bar and institutional support, the upcoming late May earnings release could trigger significant upside, potentially exceeding 100% as the market recognizes MongoDB's competitive advantages in AI applications through its Atlas platform.

title: Alphabet Earnings Didn't Just Beat—They Changed the Story
summary: Alphabet delivered exceptional Q1 2026 results with 22% revenue growth to $109.9B, beating estimates across all major metrics. Google Cloud was the standout performer with 63% YoY growth and $20.03B in revenue, while Search queries hit all-time highs. The company raised CapEx guidance to $180-190B, signaling continued aggressive AI investment. With a $460B cloud backlog and 350M paid subscriptions, analysts expect price target revisions.

title: Nvidia stock hits all-time high as AI momentum boosts market cap prospects
summary: Nvidia's stock has reached an all-time high, driven by the strong momentum in artificial intelligence technologies, positioning it to potentially become the largest company by market cap by the end of April. Despite geopolitical tensions impacting global costs, the demand for AI semiconductors and data center hardware continues to surge. While short-term predictions are highly optimistic for Nvidia, longer-term forecasts for June 30 show moderate impact, suggesting potential volatility from external factors such as FOMC meetings and geopolitical developments.

title: KeyBanc Finds Trimble Inc (TRMB)'s AI Position Stronger Than Expected
summary: KeyBanc has reiterated its Overweight rating on Trimble Inc (TRMB) with a $94 price target after management discussions revealed the company's AI development is stronger than anticipated. This confidence is bolstered by Trimble's recent acquisition of Document Crunch, an AI firm specializing in analyzing construction documents for risks, which will integrate into Trimble's AECO segment. The firm believes Trimble's AI capabilities will drive growth and cross-selling opportunities.

title: SPS Commerce SPSC Q1 2026 Earnings Transcript
summary: SPS Commerce reported Q1 2026 revenue of $192.1 million, a 6% increase, with recurring revenue up 7%. The company is navigating Amazon-related revenue recovery headwinds, which have impacted customer churn and guidance, but expects these to trough by mid to end of 2026. SPS Commerce is focusing on cross-selling to 1P customers, leveraging AI-enabled solutions like MAX for operational efficiency, and returning capital to shareholders through share repurchases, while maintaining a long-term growth target of high single digits.

title: Is Amazon Stock Still an Undervalued Stock to Buy?
summary: Amazon's Q1 2026 earnings results significantly changed the investment case for the company. The report highlighted accelerating revenue growth in Amazon's most lucrative segment, AWS, driven by AI growth. Amazon stock rose 27% in one month and became the best-performing Magnificent Seven stock in 2026, though analysts present both bullish reasons to buy in May and cautionary concerns about vulnerability.

title: Here's Why This Remains My Least Favorite "Magnificent Seven" Stock -- Even After a Strong Earnings Report
summary: Despite Microsoft's strong Q3 2026 earnings with 18% revenue growth and a $37 billion AI business run rate, analyst Daniel Sparks remains bearish on the stock. Azure's growth of 39% shows minimal acceleration compared to competitors, while AWS and Google Cloud are reaccelerating sharply. Additionally, AI threatens to disrupt Microsoft's profitable per-seat Office licensing model, and the company's revised OpenAI exclusivity deal weakens a key AI advantage.

title: While "Magnificent Seven" Companies Pour Hundreds of Billions into AI Infrastructure, Apple Continues to Execute the Classic Shareholder-Friendly Playbook
summary: Apple reported Q2 2026 earnings that beat estimates, raising its quarterly dividend by 4% to $0.27 per share and authorizing a $100 billion share repurchase program. While other 'Magnificent Seven' companies like Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta are investing heavily in AI infrastructure with capex exceeding $100 billion annually, Apple continues its traditional shareholder-friendly approach, having repurchased $37 billion in stock and distributed $7.7 billion in dividends in the first half of fiscal 2026.

title: Lightwave Logic (LWLG) Soars 16.7% on AI Boom
summary: Lightwave Logic (LWLG) stock soared 16.7% on the back of the AI boom, reflecting broader market gains. The increase follows an announcement that Lightwave's high-speed modulator platform is now available within the GDSFactory process design kit, integrated with GlobalFoundries' silicon photonics manufacturing platform. This integration enables customers to embed Lightwave's polymer-based modulator technology directly into their photonic integrated circuit designs, which the company sees as a significant step towards commercial deployment.

title: Garrett Motion (GTX) Soars to All-Time High on Earnings Blowout, Upbeat Guidance
summary: Garrett Motion Inc. (NASDAQ:GTX) stock surged to an all-time high after reporting strong first-quarter earnings, with net income growing 53% and net sales up 12%. The company also raised its full-year GAAP net income forecast and upgraded the upper end of its net sales growth guidance, while announcing a $0.08 dividend. This performance signals robust demand from commercial vehicles and passenger cars.
